HochSchulz_2022_Melanoma base cache

knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE)

repo_candidates <- unique(normalizePath(c(
  getwd(),
  file.path(getwd(), ".."),
  file.path(getwd(), "..", ".."),
  file.path(getwd(), "..", "..", "..")
), mustWork = FALSE))
repo_hit <- vapply(repo_candidates, function(path) {
  desc <- file.path(path, "DESCRIPTION")
  file.exists(desc) && any(grepl("^Package: CellEdgeR$", readLines(desc)))
}, logical(1))
root_dir <- if (any(repo_hit)) repo_candidates[which(repo_hit)[1]] else NA_character_
use_local <- !is.na(root_dir)

Analysis Summary

  • Purpose: exploratory validation contrast, not a causal or predictive claim.
  • Dataset: HochSchulz 2022 Melanoma from imcdatasets (full_dataset = FALSE, one graph per image_name).
  • Differential motif contrast: patient_treatment_group_before_surgery, coefficient patient_treatment_group_before_surgeryICI = ICI vs untreated.
  • logFC direction: positive = higher in ICI; negative = higher in untreated.
  • Images analyzed: 47 (untreated = 38, ICI = 9).
  • Images excluded from this contrast: unknown = 3.
  • Cell label column: cell_type.
  • Labels used (10): CD38, CD8- T cell, CD8+ T cell, HLA-DR, Macrophage, Neutrophil, Stroma, Tumor, unknown, Vasculature.
  • Total cells analyzed: 303727.

Volcano Plots

  • Points are colored by FDR <= 0.05.
  • Positive logFC: enriched in ICI.
  • Negative logFC: enriched in untreated.

Summary: 47 samples, 303727 cells, 10 labels, edge length cutoff = 40.6.
